Yaadein wo bachati hain jo waqt dafnaana chahta hai.
Chalak dimaag apne hi daron ko maat de deta hai.
Ek chalak muskaan bach nikalne wale ki pehchaan hai.
Chalak chor apne hi bhavishya se chori karta hai.
Aatma vichaaron ka chehra pahne.
Moorh shor khoje; gyaani gahrai khoje.
Dar kaagaj ke bagh hain.
Agyan sabse tez bole.
Jeevan ko saans se nahi, palon se maapo.
Sankhyaayein brahmand par raj kare.
Rooh chupchaap ladi ladaiyon ke zakhm pehnti hai.
Garibi darshan ki bahan hai.
Hansi dukh ki kshanik mrityu hai.
Buddhi zameen khojti hai, dil unhe aabaad karta hai.
Gyaan chhupi hui sone se behtar hai.
Teekhi jeebh do-dhaari talwar hai.
Buddhi andar ki divya aag ki chingari hai.
Aatma ko shaanti kewal satya mein mile.
Moorkh mann ki baat bolta hai; gyaani ispar niyantran rakhta hai.
Teekhi jeebh koi chikna rasta nahi banati.
Khamoshi mein teekhe vicharon ka toofan chhipa hota hai.
Teekhi buddhi ek khamosh hatyara hai.
Moh bandhanon ki jad hai.
Lalach ek atal pyaala hai.
Rooh apni har haari hui ladai yaad rakhti hai.
Ek chatur chaal sabse budhiman nyayadhish ko uljha deti hai.
Junoon banaye hue pul ko jala deta hai.
Ummeed pathrili zameen ka ek nazuk phool hai.
Teekha mazak gyaani ka hathiyar hai.
Irshya vah zehar hai jo khud peeya jaye.
Ahankari manushya bina patwaar ka jahaj hai.
Madhu ki ek boond sirke se jyada makkhiyaan pakde.
Man chhaaiyon ka rangmanch hai.
Ahankar se bharne par aatma ki naav chhed ho jaati hai.
Teekhi buddhi sabse bhaari kavach ko hara deti hai.
Ek khushnuma mazak dukh ki sabse acchi dawa hai.
Sach hazaron chalak mukhauton ke peeche chhipa hai.
Teekhi dhaar dushman aur dost dono ko kaat ti hai.
Samay gyaani vaidya hai.
Rooh un sachhaiyon ke liye tadapti hai jo boli na jayein.
Gyaani apani chup se pahchane jaaye.
Ek khushnuma geet adharat toofaan ko chunauti deta hai.
Gyan apni agyanta ki gehrai ko janana hai.
Buddhi dar se zang laga hua disha suchak hai.
Manushya bhramon ka shikari hai.
Jo khud ki seva kare, uska maalik bura hota hai.
Shaant paani anant ko pratibimbabit kare.
Gyaani vyakti kisi bhi cheez ki ati nahi karta.
Aadat doosri prakriti hai jo pahli ka gala ghonte.
